description: Edits and simulates deterministic finite automata.

methods.name: addEdge(source: string, target: string, type = TP_DFA_TRANSITION, sourcePort?: TpGraphPort, targetPort?: TpGraphPort, direction: TpGraphEdgeDirection = "forward"): TpGraphEdge
methods.description: Adds a forward transition between existing state IDs, using optional connection ports; returns the edge record. Unsupported types, directions or endpoints throw.

methods.name: addMeasurement(edgeId: string, position = 0.5, label?: string): TpGraphMeasurement
methods.description: Adds a measurement marker to edgeId at a position clamped to 0..1 along the edge; returns its detached record. Throws for an unknown edge.

methods.name: addNode(type: string, point: TpGraphPoint, label?: string): TpGraphNode
methods.description: Adds a DFA state or comment at graph coordinates point with the optional label; returns a detached node record. Unsupported types throw TypeError.

methods.name: animateTransition(transition: TpGraphTransition): Promise<void>
methods.description: Applies node and edge patches to existing IDs, animates their appearance for transition.duration milliseconds (300 by default), then records the change. Resolves after that duration.

methods.name: collapsePalette(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Collapses all shape palette sections.

methods.name: copy(): boolean
methods.description: Copies the selected graph elements and connecting edges into the editor-local clipboard. Returns false when nothing is selected; does not use the system clipboard.

methods.name: cut(): boolean
methods.description: Copies the selection into the editor-local clipboard, then removes it and connected edges as an undoable change. Returns false when readonly or nothing is selected.

methods.name: deleteSelection(): void
methods.description: Deletes the currently selected graph objects.

methods.name: downloadJson(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Saves the complete graph as JSON.

methods.name: expandPalette(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Expands all shape palette sections.

methods.name: exportJson(pretty = true): string
methods.description: Returns the graph serialized as JSON; pretty uses two-space indentation, while false produces compact JSON.

methods.name: exportSvg(): string
methods.description: Returns a standalone SVG of the graph with resolved styles and content bounds; throws when the canvas is not ready.

methods.name: importJson(source: string): void
methods.description: Parses and validates a JSON graph, replaces the current graph and emits tp-graph-import. Invalid JSON or graph data throws before replacement.

methods.name: moveMeasurement(id: string, position: number): void
methods.description: Moves the marker identified by id to a relative edge position clamped to 0..1; throws when the marker is unknown.

methods.name: openFile(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Opens the graph JSON file chooser.

methods.name: openLabelEditor(id: string): void
methods.description: Opens the label editor for the specified graph object.

methods.name: openTitleEditor(): void
methods.description: Opens the graph title editor.

methods.name: paste(): string | null
methods.description: Duplicates the editor-local clipboard with new IDs and an offset, then selects the copies. Returns the first pasted ID, or null when readonly or no clipboard content is available.

methods.name: readNext(duration = 300): Promise<boolean>
methods.description: Consumes and animates one input symbol using duration milliseconds. Resolves to true if a symbol was processed, not whether the word is accepted; false means no further step is possible.

methods.name: reconnectEdge(edgeId: string, endpoint: "source" | "target", nodeId: string, port: TpGraphPort): TpGraphEdge
methods.description: Moves the source or target endpoint of edgeId to nodeId and port after connection validation; returns a detached copy of the updated edge.

methods.name: redo(): boolean
methods.description: Restores the next undone graph snapshot and returns true; returns false when redo history is empty.

methods.name: registerPalette(palette: TpGraphPalette): void
methods.description: Registers or replaces a shape palette by its ID and refreshes the palette UI. Requires a nonempty ID and at least one shape.

methods.name: registerSimulator(name: string, simulator: TpGraphSimulator): void
methods.description: Registers or replaces the simulator function associated with name for subsequent step(name) calls.

methods.name: removeElement(id: string): void
methods.description: Removes the node, edge or measurement identified by id; removing a node also removes its connected edges. Updates selection and records an undoable change.

methods.name: reset(word = this.inputWord): void
methods.description: Restarts reading word at the initial state and clears rejection and transition highlights; omitted word reuses the current input. Emits tp-dfa-reset.

methods.name: resetZoom(): void
methods.description: Restores magnification to 1 (100%) without changing graph data.

methods.name: run(duration = 600): Promise<boolean>
methods.description: Processes remaining symbols with duration milliseconds per step, stopping at the end or rejection. Resolves to whether the complete word is accepted; does not reset the input first.

methods.name: selectCommentColor(value: string | undefined): void
methods.description: Selects the color of subsequently inserted comments, closes the palette and refreshes it.

methods.name: selectShapeType(type: string): void
methods.description: Selects the palette shape for subsequent insertions; opens the color menu for comments.

methods.name: setCommentColor(id: string, color: TpGraphCommentColor): void
methods.description: Changes the color of a comment node and records the change; throws for an unknown comment or unsupported color.

methods.name: setEdgeDirection(edgeId: string, direction: TpGraphEdgeDirection): void
methods.description: Changes an existing edge direction and the default for new edges; throws for an unknown edge or a direction unsupported by this editor.

methods.name: setEdgeOrthogonal(edgeId: string, elbows: 1 | 2 | 3, departure: "horizontal" | "vertical", turns: "alternating" | "same" = "alternating"): void
methods.description: Uses orthogonal routing with 1, 2 or 3 elbows and a horizontal or vertical departure. The turns choice applies to two elbows; throws for an unknown edge.

methods.name: setEdgeRouting(edgeId: string, routing: TpGraphEdgeRouting): void
methods.description: Changes an existing edge routing mode and the default for new edges; throws for an unknown edge.

methods.name: setElementLabel(id: string, label: string): void
methods.description: Sets the trimmed label of a node, edge or measurement by ID; empty clears the label. Throws for an unknown element.

methods.name: setGraph(graph: TpGraphDocument): void
methods.description: Validates the specialized graph before replacing the editor graph; retains the base editor cloning and undo-history behavior. Invalid data throws without replacing the graph.

methods.name: setTitle(title: string): void
methods.description: Trims and stores the graph title, then records an undoable change; an empty string removes visible title text.

methods.name: setZoom(value: number): void
methods.description: Sets a positive finite magnification factor, clamped to the supported zoom range. A value of 1 means 100%; invalid inputs throw TypeError.

methods.name: step(simulatorName: string): Promise<void>
methods.description: Runs the simulator registered as simulatorName on a graph snapshot, awaits its animated transition and emits tp-graph-simulation-step. Throws for an unknown simulator.

methods.name: syncGraphCode(): void
methods.description: Applies edited graph JSON, or refreshes the JSON from the current graph when unchanged or read-only.

methods.name: toggleAreaSelection(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Enables or disables rectangular graph selection.

methods.name: toggleEditorToolbar(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Shows or hides the JSON editor toolbar.

methods.name: toggleGrid(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Shows or hides the graph grid.

methods.name: toggleJson(): Promise<void>
methods.description: Shows or hides the graph JSON panel.

methods.name: undo(): boolean
methods.description: Restores the preceding graph snapshot and returns true; returns false when undo history is empty.

methods.name: unregisterPalette(id: string): void
methods.description: Removes the palette with the supplied ID and selects a remaining shape if needed; does not remove existing graph nodes.

methods.name: zoomIn(): void
methods.description: Increases magnification by the configured zoom factor, up to the supported maximum.

methods.name: zoomOut(): void
methods.description: Decreases magnification by the configured zoom factor, down to the supported minimum.

events.name: tp-dfa-reset
events.description: Emitted after the input word, consumed-symbol count and active state are reset. stateId is null when no initial state is available; graph is the resulting snapshot.
events.detail: { word: string; stateId: string | null; graph: TpGraphDocument }

events.name: tp-dfa-step
events.description: Emitted after consuming one symbol and completing its transition animation. position is the number of consumed symbols; accepted and rejected describe the resulting state.
events.detail: { symbol: string; position: number; stateId: string | null; accepted: boolean; rejected: boolean; graph: TpGraphDocument }

userHelp.introduction: The custom `<tp-graph-dfa>` element edits and simulates deterministic finite automata.
userHelp.interactions:
#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Component itself | No dedicated pointer control; use any displayed child controls normally. |
| :tp-icon:{name="refresh" size="2em"} Reset word | Reset word. |
| :tp-icon:{name="play" size="2em"} Read next symbol | Read next symbol. |
| :tp-icon:{name="playlist-play" size="2em"} Run word | Run word. |
| :tp-icon:{name="keyboard-f1" size="2em"} Toggle editor toolbar | Toggle editor toolbar. |
| :tp-icon:{name="sync" size="2em"} Synchronize graph and JSON | Synchronize graph and JSON. |
| :tp-icon:{name="arrow-expand-vertical" size="2em"} Expand all | Expand all. |
| :tp-icon:{name="arrow-collapse-vertical" size="2em"} Collapse all | Collapse all. |
| :tp-icon:{name="undo" size="2em"} Undo | Undo. |
| :tp-icon:{name="redo" size="2em"} Redo | Redo. |
| :tp-icon:{name="select" size="2em"} Select area | Select area. |
| :tp-icon:{name="content-copy" size="2em"} Copy | Copy. |
| :tp-icon:{name="content-cut" size="2em"} Cut | Cut. |
| :tp-icon:{name="content-paste" size="2em"} Paste | Paste. |
| :tp-icon:{name="text-short" size="2em"} Label | Label. |
| :tp-icon:{name="format-title" size="2em"} Graph title | Graph title. |
| :tp-icon:{name="magnify-minus-outline" size="2em"} Zoom out | Zoom out. |
| :tp-icon:{name="magnify-plus-outline" size="2em"} Zoom in | Zoom in. |
| :tp-icon:{name="grid" size="2em"} Show or hide grid | Show or hide grid. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file-upload" size="2em"} Import JSON | Import JSON. |
| :tp-icon:{name="file-download" size="2em"} Export JSON | Export JSON. |
| :tp-icon:{name="language-json" size="2em"} Show or hide graph JSON | Show or hide graph JSON. |
| :tp-icon:{name="palette-swatch" size="2em"} Color | Choose an accent color. |
| :tp-icon:{name="theme-light-dark" size="2em"} Theme | Choose the light, dark or automatic theme. |
| :tp-icon:{name="fullscreen" size="2em"} :tp-icon:{name="fullscreen-exit" size="2em"} Fullscreen | Enter or leave fullscreen. |
| :tp-icon:{name="save-image" size="2em"} Save image | Save the content as an image. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Play | <kbd>Enter</kbd> a word in the toolbar below the canvas. **Play** consumes the next symbol and highlights the active transition and state. **Run word** reads the complete word automatically with a visible 600 ms interval between transitions. **Reset** returns to the initial state. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
